sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied san-rafael-elementary-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Hand re-traced on 2026-10-08 from the owner image at enlarged scale: every distinguishable crown, canopy belt, lawn, planted bed, garden plot, hedge, path, apron, court and parking area is traced where the image shows it, and bare ground stays bare. Re-registered by hand (similarity fit). Mostly roofs. Crowns: the large-leaved canopy north-west of the angled roof, the palm line on the west edge, a small tree beside the angled roof, the crown at the long east roof's south end and the canopy along the south yard. Hardscape: the south yard in front of the west classroom block and the long corridor between the middle blocks and the east block. The pale ground north-west of the light roof and the narrow shadowed gaps stay bare. Registration: hand similarity fit to hand-picked OSM roof corners and junctions; independent check errors 1.56 m, 1.33 m. Trunks sit inside their observed crowns; crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
